cards.question: What does the OSI model stand for?
How many layers does the OSI model have?
Which OSI layer do web browsers and email clients operate at?
Name four protocols that operate at the Application Layer.
What three main operations does the Presentation Layer perform?
SSL and TLS are associated with which OSI layer?
What is the primary responsibility of the Session Layer?
cards.answer: Establishing, maintaining, and closing sessions between devices

cards.question: Name three protocols that operate at the Session Layer.
What does the Transport Layer guarantee between two communicating devices?
Name three protocols that operate at the Transport Layer.
What unit of data does the Network Layer route?
Name three protocols that operate at the Network Layer.
What unit of data does the Data Link Layer work with?
Which three types of devices operate at the Data Link Layer?
What does the Physical Layer transmit?
cards.answer: Raw bits over a physical medium

cards.question: Which devices operate at the Physical Layer?
List the 7 OSI layers from highest to lowest.
cards.answer: Application, Presentation, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link, Physical

cards.question: Which two protocols are associated with both the Data Link and Physical layers?
What are the two main functions of the Network Layer?
What four functions does the Transport Layer perform?
cards.answer: Segmentation, acknowledgement, re-delivery, and flow control

JSON and XML are data formats associated with the _____ layer.
